name: ALSee (알씨)
price: Free with ads; AD-ZERO ad removal 5,900 KRW/month (all ALTools); ALTools AI subscription for AI features
summary: ESTsoft's long-standing Korean image viewer from the ALTools family (ALZip, ALYac): thumbnail/list browsing, large and full-screen view, images inside archives, batch convert/resize/rotate, printing, and subscription AI edits (upscaling, background removal, face mosaic).
where_it_wins: AI upscaling, background removal, face mosaic (subscription)
Integrates with Windows Explorer context menu
where_schnellbild_wins: Runs natively on the Mac (Apple silicon), Honeyview/BandiView-style viewing without Windows or Wine
Plays videos (MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI …) in the same grid and slideshow
Thumbnail grid with folder previews and list view, recursive name search with regular expressions
Free with every feature, no ads, open source, App Sandbox, never goes online
Dual pane with F5/F6 copy/move, undo for file actions

free.note: Free with ads; ad removal via ALTools AD-ZERO subscription (5,900 KRW/month); AI features via ALTools AI subscription
